movie_title: 15 killed after bus carrying 42 students collided with minivan in Malaysia
introduction: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has ordered a probe into a fatal crash in the northern state

vocabulary.example: The police ordered a probe into the cause of the fatal crash.

vocabulary.definition: to yield to superior strength or force or overpowering appeal or desire
vocabulary.example: Despite the efforts of the medical team, the patient succumbed to his illness.

vocabulary.definition: expressions of sympathy and sorrow for someone's loss
vocabulary.example: The Prime Minister extended his condolences to the families of the victims.

vocabulary.definition: to form a theory or conjecture about a subject without firm evidence
vocabulary.example: It is not appropriate to speculate about the cause of the accident before the investigation is completed.

vocabulary.definition: subjected to lasting shock as a result of an emotionally disturbing experience
vocabulary.example: The survivors of the crash were traumatized by the events they witnessed.

vocabulary.definition: to officially require or command something
vocabulary.example: The government is considering mandating speed limiters on heavy vehicles to improve road safety.
